shortener.message: This file describes a URL shortener, not an uploader. put.gd imports image, text and file uploaders only.

plainHTTP.message: This address uses plain HTTP, which sends the file and its credentials unencrypted. Use https://, or turn on Allow plain HTTP for this destination.

deletionElsewhere.reason: The server returned a deletion URL on another host than this destination's request URL. It would take a stored value of this destination there, so put.gd did not keep it and cannot delete this upload from the server. Delete it on the server itself.
